title: Text: DET Ben Fidelman ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: When are you guys announcing the teal Pistons jerseys? Is there going to be a presser at Comerica where photographers would be welcome?
Questioned “When are you guys announcing the teal Pistons jerseys? Is there going to be a presser at Comerica where photographers would be welcome?”
Our photogs are tied up with auto show so they need to know if we need one for that
There will be no press event, photos are available during caravan
When are you guys announcing it?
Oh NEXT week? Thought it was this week. Thanks
